ideas.name: flip1 with value migrating its way
ideas.why: today's busiest price above yesterday's means the market is accepting higher prices; long flips go with that (short mirrored)

ideas.name: flip1 its way after an open outside value
ideas.why: an RTH open above yesterday's value area (or below) is an imbalance open (Dalton); flips that way carry

ideas.name: any warning after an open inside value
ideas.why: an open inside yesterday's value is a balance open; the day rotates, so called turns come true

ideas.name: flip1 when 5m ADX is over 25
ideas.why: a trending tape by ADX lets flips run

ideas.name: any warning when 5m ADX is under 20
ideas.why: a trendless tape by ADX rotates, so called turns come true

ideas.name: flip1 its way on a big-gap day
ideas.why: an RTH open half the usual range from settlement is a gap day; flips the gap's way carry the overnight news

ideas.name: any warning calling through VWAP just after a touch
ideas.why: VWAP breaks more often than it holds (confirmed lean): a warning that calls price through VWAP within 3 bars of touching it
